what: Stage A of the GPU-resident frames: instant model toggles (exact chl/bath show, warm frames of the other published waves sets on a resting wheel, the orchestrator seam). Offline A/B on ONE combined build (Stage A + #453 client), arms interleaved per round; off = window.__RAW_DISABLE_FRAME_MODEL_TOGGLE__ = true (today's switch).

harness.backend: serve_synthetic.py --models GFS,ICON,EURO (synthetic store, 115 GFS/ICON frames, 99 EURO)
harness.cdn: #453's publish_frame_images.py --only frames over that store (3 waves sets), served locally with CDN_LAT
harness.plan: per session 10 model clicks at hours 0, 24, 168 (GFS/ICON/EURO in every order), each followed by one wheel step

run_notes.toggle_ab: arms on/off, 2 rounds, interleaved (on,off then off,on); build without the desktop-only chl/bath gate (desktop is unaffected by it)
run_notes.toggle_themes: on-light, on-beach (the on-handheld session there failed in the harness: the phone layout hides an exact-text Waves button; fixed and re-run as toggle_phone)
run_notes.toggle_phone: on-handheld on the FINAL build (desktop-only chl/bath gate): every click takes the normal path, as intended
run_notes.toggle_final: one desktop on session on the FINAL build: unchanged from toggle_ab

gates.mutants: 18/18 killed (scratchpad mutants_stagea.py): no chl/bath upload; identity keeps the old model; resident not updated after an aux show; warm sets get texture arrays; warm frames on any tier; no bounds check; no sync rate limit; no GPU upload when a warm set turns active; texture check skipped; no idle chl/bath for warm frames; aux kill ignored; toggle kill ignored; warm frames aborted on replan; deferred switch dropped when the seam moves the prefetch; switch ignores the fetch model resolution; switch ignores the backend lane; warm frames follow a moving wheel; phones compute chl/bath on the main thread

caveats: Synthetic store: every model shares one grid and one land mask, so the chl/bath compute hits the getMarineGeoData cache (~0 ms); on real frames it costs ~63 ms each, done in idle time and only on a desktop.
A real ICON/EURO world grid whose trimmed size or bounds differ from GFS would be refused (shows.auxMiss dims/bounds): only the live read after #453 publishes those sets can tell.
off arm and phone: about one wrong-model frame per click is drawn before the status line re-renders (pre-existing: the switch as it is today).
